description: Lignes de Tram is a dataset listed in Open Data Val'Metro, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SIMOUV. Coverage: Valenciennes Métropole. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité. Its keywords are Tramway, Tram, Transport en commune, Transport, Déplacement, Mobilité. The portal shows 2 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-04-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-valenciennesmetro-portal.
